mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above a 5% YoY growth rate signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 2% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) decreases by more than 100,000 jobs in the same month, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000 jobs MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a weakening demand side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST YoY decline > 10% and RSAFS YoY growth < 2%
failure_condition: If HOUST declines by more than 10% YoY and RSAFS growth is below 2% YoY and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% MoM during a late-cycle expansion and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
